# LUMA SOCIAL — client facts

## Positioning

- Brand: LUMA SOCIAL
- Product: alcohol-free botanical sparkling drink
- Audience: adults seeking a welcoming drink ritual
- Occasions: dinners, gatherings and evening cultural events
- Fixed direction: adult evening sociability
- Open visual choices: logo, color palette, typeface, illustration and composition

## Exact public copy

| Field | Copy |
| --- | --- |
| Brand name | LUMA SOCIAL |
| Campaign line | Stay for the moment. |
| Product descriptor | Alcohol-free botanical sparkling drink |
| Serving copy | Serve chilled. |

## Shared product record

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Volume per can | 250 ml |
| Alcohol content | 0.0% alcohol |
| Price per can | $4 |
| Serving | Serve chilled. |
| Botanical pairing text | Flavor-description copy |

## Three flavors

| Flavor name | Taste notes | Botanical pairing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Citrus & Rosemary | Bright citrus, herbal finish. | Citrus peel and rosemary. |
| Berry & Hibiscus | Red berry, floral finish. | Red berries and hibiscus. |
| Pear & Ginger | Soft pear, gentle spice. | Pear and ginger. |

## Content and identity

- Public-facing language: English
- Copy flexibility: line breaks, typographic capitalization and equivalent typographic punctuation, with all words, numbers and meaning retained
- Event-time punctuation example: an en dash equivalent to the hyphen
- Flavor association: name, taste notes, botanical pairing and visual cue connected to the same flavor
- Range identity: three distinguishable flavors within one recognizable brand
- Flavor identification: readable flavor names supported by visual cues
- Single-flavor identification: the featured flavor’s name
- General brand identification: LUMA SOCIAL
- Additional expressive copy and imagery: adult social occasion and atmosphere
- Product communication fields: descriptor, flavor, taste notes, botanical pairing, volume, alcohol content, price and serving copy
- Event communication fields: event name, descriptor, date, time and venue

## Application geometry and carrier

- Application type: flat can-surface brand graphics
- Front panel: width 80 mm; height 100 mm
- Back panel: width 80 mm; height 100 mm
- Front and back: separate graphic panels
- Shared carrier: plain silver aluminum can
- Recognizable carrier features: cylindrical body, rounded shoulders, pull-tab top

## Tasting event

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Event name | Evening, Together |
| Event descriptor | Tasting evening |
| Date | 10 October 2026 |
| Time | 18:00-21:00 |
| Venue | The Glasshouse, 18 Willow Lane |

- Complete event-record placements: event poster; event social invitation in tier 24
- General launch campaign timing: ongoing brand launch communication

steps.userMessage:
LUMA SOCIAL | Alcohol-free botanical drinks for evening company

We are launching an alcohol-free botanical sparkling drink for adults who enjoy the ritual of a drink over dinner, at a gathering or during an evening cultural event. Build the identity around this welcoming, adult social positioning. The logo, typography, palette, illustration and composition are open for development. Print the brand name as "LUMA SOCIAL", the campaign line as "Stay for the moment." and the product descriptor as "Alcohol-free botanical sparkling drink" on the applications specified below. The attached plain silver can is the shared product carrier; retain its recognizable cylindrical silhouette, rounded shoulders and pull-tab top in product imagery.

The range is Citrus & Rosemary, Berry & Hibiscus and Pear & Ginger. Each can contains 250 ml with 0.0% alcohol, costs $4 and carries the serving copy Serve chilled. Each flavor needs a readable name and its own visual cue within one recognizable family. The can artwork uses separate flat front and back panels, each 80 mm wide × 100 mm high. Our tasting event is Evening, Together, described as Tasting evening, on 10 October 2026, 18:00-21:00, at The Glasshouse, 18 Willow Lane. Put this complete event record on the event poster and on the event social invitation where one is delivered. Public-facing copy is English; line breaks, typographic capitalization and equivalent punctuation may vary while retaining the supplied wording and meaning. Product, price and event copy throughout the work draws on the attached facts.

Audience: our brand, retail and events teams, choosing the launch identity and preparing its use at dinner tables, stockists and evening gatherings.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the positioning, product records, exact copy, event details and application dimensions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. can-panel-geometry.png gives the fixed dimensions of the front and back graphic surfaces. plain-can-lineup.png records the shared silver can carrier and its recognizable features. evening-company.png provides atmosphere for adult company, table lighting and the rhythm of an evening gathering.

Deliverables:
1. One one-page brand specification recording the adult evening positioning, master logo, primary color code, typography, three named flavor cues, product descriptor and campaign line
2. Three finished logo assets: master, horizontal and single-color
3. Three can fronts, one per flavor, each an 80 mm × 100 mm flat graphic panel with the brand name, product descriptor, campaign line, flavor name, corresponding taste notes, 250 ml, 0.0% alcohol and Serve chilled.
4. Two posters: a general launch poster with the brand name, descriptor and campaign line, and an Evening, Together poster with the brand name and complete tasting-event record
5. One dinner drinks menu with the brand name, all three flavors, their taste notes and botanical pairings, 250 ml, 0.0% alcohol, $4 per can and Serve chilled.
6. One retail shelf sign with the brand name, all three flavor names, 250 ml, 0.0% alcohol and $4 per can
7. One general launch social visual with the brand name, campaign line and all three flavor names
8. One 15-second brand film reusing the delivered logo, all three can fronts and launch-poster visuals, with readable brand name, product descriptor and campaign line
9. One launch presentation of at least 8 pages reusing the specification, three logo assets, three can fronts, both posters, menu, shelf sign, social visual and film stills

Acceptance:
- The brand specification comes first and records one primary color code, three named flavor cues, Alcohol-free botanical sparkling drink and Stay for the moment.; the can fronts, general launch poster and film repeat both phrases and use that primary color. The presentation repeats the code, phrases and three flavor cues.
- The three logo assets retain the same identifying forms, and the can fronts, posters, menu, shelf sign, social visual, film and presentation carry a readable LUMA SOCIAL name.
- Each can front measures 80 mm × 100 mm, carries 250 ml, 0.0% alcohol and Serve chilled., and pairs its flavor with the correct taste notes: Citrus & Rosemary with Bright citrus, herbal finish.; Berry & Hibiscus with Red berry, floral finish.; Pear & Ginger with Soft pear, gentle spice. The specification’s corresponding flavor cue appears on each front and follows that flavor into the menu, shelf sign, social visual, film and presentation.
- The dinner menu gives all three flavor names, matching taste notes and botanical pairings from 01-client-facts.en.md, plus Serve chilled.; both the menu and retail shelf sign state 250 ml, 0.0% alcohol and $4 per can.
- The event poster prints Evening, Together, Tasting evening, 10 October 2026, 18:00-21:00 and The Glasshouse, 18 Willow Lane; the general launch poster and launch social visual print Stay for the moment., and the social visual names all three flavors.
- The film lasts 15 seconds and reuses the delivered master logo, three can fronts and general launch-poster visuals; the presentation has at least 8 pages and contains every earlier deliverable, with the film represented by stills.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
